src.label: Consulate General of the Dominican Republic in Montreal — FAQ on travelling with a pet; CNMSF (Dominican SPS committee) — Ganadería updates certificate to import pets (24 April 2024)

head: A vet health certificate dated within 30 days is checked on arrival by the animal control officer.
lines: The Dominican consulate in Montreal says each pet needs a health certificate issued and signed by an authorised vet, stating the pet was examined within 30 days before departure, is free of infectious disease, was treated against internal and external parasites and is vaccinated against rabies. The rabies certificate shows the vaccination date, period of immunity, product name and serial number.
On arrival you ask for the animal control officer, who checks the vet certificates, and you fill in an official pet entry permit form.

A 2024 news item from the national SPS committee adds that the Dirección General de Ganadería updated its certificate for importing pets: it must be signed by a vet and countersigned and sealed by an official vet, covers vaccines and parasite control, and can be obtained in about 24 hours.
